groups.name: mechanical-cutting-plane-and-hatching
groups.notes: New question explicitly distinguishes thin one-dot chain form plus thick ends/direction changes. Reused sectional-view question tests material cut-surface role; it does not establish exact solid-line hatching appearance. All four old options/reasons self-compared. Hatch-shape remains open.

groups.name: electrical-manual-reset-and-drawing-motion
groups.notes: New conditional textbook question checks safety before manual signal reset, not automatic reset or repeated restarting; not a universal device procedure or hands-on approval. Existing electrical drawing question directly distinguishes moving-position phantom lines from hatching; cross-specialty assessment location remains explicit, not a claim that every mechanical weekly test now contains it.

groups.name: surface-solution-roles-and-precipitation
groups.notes: New P/Q/R paper model independently tests all three roles and uniform resulting liquid with distinct permutations. Reused aqueous AgCl question assesses recognition of precipitation only: given ions/colour do not assess separate ionic-reaction or colour-specific facts. Source printed missing chloride charge is not copied as correct notation.
